classification.difficultyReason: Interpret opposite percentage changes, determine their net effect and explain why reversing their order gives the same result.

children.label: a
children.prompt: A shirt is discounted by $50\%$ and the resulting price is then increased by $50\%$. By what percentage is the price increased or decreased from its original value?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Final price}&=\text{original price}\times0.5\times1.5\\\text{Final price}&=\text{original price}\times0.75\end{align*}$$

The final price is $75\%$ of the original, so the decrease is $100\%-75\%=25\%$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: The price of a shirt is increased by $50\%$ and the resulting price is then decreased by $50\%$. By what percentage is the price increased or decreased from its original value?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Final price}&=\text{original price}\times1.5\times0.5\\\text{Final price}&=\text{original price}\times0.75\end{align*}$$

The final price is $75\%$ of the original, so the decrease is $100\%-75\%=25\%$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Can you explain the relationship between your answers to parts a and b?

answer.worked: Changing the order of multiplication does not change the product: $\frac12\times\frac32=\frac32\times\frac12=\frac34$. Both final prices are $75\%$ of the original price, so both give a $25\%$ decrease.
